scratch.en: It had a tremendous headstart. Unlike other political parties, it wasn’t starting from scratch.
scratch.zh: 它有着巨大的领先优势。与其他政党不同，它不是从零开始的。

scratch.en: In Henning's study, when people watched videos of scratching, they scratched themselves spontaneously.
scratch.zh: 在 Henning 的研究中，人们在观看挠痒视频时，会不由自主地挠起自己来。

scratch.en: In Henning's study, when people watched videos of scratching, they scratched themselves spontaneously.
scratch.zh: 在 Henning 的研究中，人们在观看挠痒视频时，会不由自主地挠起自己来。

scratch.en: Rome had no navy to speak of when it began, but it built one from scratch.
scratch.zh: 战争爆发时，罗马几乎没有海军，但他们从零开始打造了一支。

scratch.en: One man, Wyatt Earp, is standing without a scratch.
scratch.zh: 只有一个人——Wyatt Earp——毫发无损地站在那里。

scientific.en: If you unpack an idea or scientific concept, you explain it in clear detail.
scientific.zh: 如果你 unpack 一个想法或科学概念，意思就是详细清楚地解释它。

scientific.en: Every scientific field, from physics to chemistry to computer science, depends on mathematical thinking.
scientific.zh: 每一个科学领域，从物理学、化学到计算机科学，都依赖于数学思维。

scientific.en: To avoid conflict, both men agreed to present their ideas together to a scientific community.
scientific.zh: 为了避免冲突，两人同意将他们的观点共同提交给科学界。

scientific.en: First of all, many people have questioned the scientific validity of the experiment.
scientific.zh: 首先，很多人质疑这项实验在科学上的有效性。

scientific.en: Because more people were able to read, scientific ideas could spread across countries.
scientific.zh: 因为更多的人能够读书，科学思想得以在各个国家传播开来。

scare.en: Again, the cycle repeats. So many people are scared to speak in English, right?
scare.zh: 同样，这个循环不断重复。很多人害怕说英语，对吧？

scare.en: In Salem Village, the devil wasn’t just a story whispered to scare children; he was real.
scare.zh: 在塞勒姆村，魔鬼可不仅仅是用来吓唬小孩子的睡前故事；他是真实存在的。

scare.en: I was a bit scared to be honest. How about you?
scare.zh: 说实话，我当时有点害怕。你呢？

scare.en: But that first thing really scared me. And once I'd done one, the second one came easier and the third one came even easier.
scare.zh: 但那第一次尝试真的吓到我了。而一旦做完第一次，第二次就变得容易了，第三次就更容易了。

scare.en: This is a problem; sharks scare away other creatures, such as sea turtles, and these creatures eat seagrass, which absorbs a lot of carbon from the atmosphere.
scare.zh: 这是个问题：鲨鱼会把海龟等其他生物吓跑，而这些生物本来是以海草为食的，海草能从大气中吸收大量的碳。

scientist.en: Scientists say the human body replaces most of its cells every seven to 10 years.
scientist.zh: 科学家说，人体每七到十年就会更换大部分细胞。

scientist.en: Caroline Steele says that scientists are looking at the potential atmosphere around TRAPPIST-1e.
scientist.zh: Caroline Steele 表示，科学家们正在研究 TRAPPIST-1e 周围的潜在大气层。

scientist.en: It’s a nice story, but most modern scientists believe it is almost certainly wrong.
scientist.zh: 这是一个美好的故事，但大多数现代科学家认为它几乎肯定是错误的。

scientist.en: As the world warms, climate scientists think that these storms will get more destructive.
scientist.zh: 随着世界变暖，气候科学家认为这些风暴将变得更具破坏性。

scientist.en: So the Curie family were a group of incredibly respected and successful experimental scientists.
scientist.zh: 所以居里家族是一群备受尊敬且极为成功的实验科学家。

scrub.en: Is it: a) deep cleaning the oven, b) scrubbing the toilet, or c) cleaning the windows?
scrub.zh: 是：a）深度清洁烤箱，b）刷马桶，还是 c）擦窗户？

scrub.en: People hate cleaning the windows even more than scrubbing the oven.
scrub.zh: 人们讨厌擦窗户甚至超过了刷烤箱。

screen.en: Screen time - that’s how much time you spend using devices like smart phones, tablets and laptops.
screen.zh: 屏幕时间——也就是你使用智能手机、平板电脑和笔记本电脑等设备所花费的时间。

screen.en: Well, Becca, we are both adults, but today we're talking about screen time and children screen time.
screen.zh: 嗯，Becca，我们都是成年人，但今天我们讨论的是屏幕时间以及儿童的屏幕时间。

screen.en: Or can you get the same result through a computer screen?
screen.zh: 还是你可以通过电脑屏幕获得同样的效果？

screen.en: 75 students applied. They were interviewed, screened to check that they didn’t have any serious medical problems, any psychological conditions, or a criminal record.
screen.zh: 有 75 名学生报名。他们接受了面试和筛选，以确认没有严重的身体疾病、心理问题或犯罪记录。

screen.en: You’re behind a screen. But when researchers actually compare online versus in-person study, the answer to which one is the best is not straightforward.
screen.zh: 你隔着一个屏幕。但是，当研究人员真正对比线上和线下学习时，哪种最好的答案并不简单。

scale.en: And now Hollywood was doing the same thing, albeit on a far larger scale.
scale.zh: 如今，好莱坞正在做着同样的事情，只是规模要大得多。

scale.en: By the late 1800s, the Christmas Island Phosphate Company had begun large scale mining operations.
scale.zh: 到 19 世纪末，圣诞岛磷酸盐公司已经开始了大规模的采矿作业。

scale.en: These people did not rely on large scale agriculture of grains.
scale.zh: 这些人并不依赖大规模的谷物农业。

scale.en: And the sheer scale of the growth in AI, and the data centres required for this, is mindboggling.
scale.zh: 人工智能增长的绝对规模，以及为此所需的数据中心，简直令人匪夷所思。

scale.en: Super helpful, and that hasn’t changed. What has changed is the scale, the speed, and the integration.
scale.zh: 超级有用，而且这一点没有改变。改变的是规模、速度和集成度。

script.en: But no one has ever been able to fully decipher the Indus script.
script.zh: 但是没有人能够完全破译印度河文字。

script.en: As a result, it was a script that many found difficult to read and write.
script.zh: 因此，许多人觉得这种文字很难读写。

script.en: And all those scripts about yourself - that you're a bad person for eating.
script.zh: 还有所有那些关于你自己的潜台词——比如因为吃东西而觉得自己是个坏人。

script.en: Mustafa Kemal himself went from town to town, teaching people how to use the new script.
script.zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔亲自走访城镇，教人们如何使用新文字。

script.en: It is what most people today think of as the "traditional" script.
script.zh: 它也是今天大多数人所认为的“传统”剧本。

scan.en: Scanning involves searching a wide area with your eyes to find some particular thing.
scan.zh: “观察”（Scanning）包括用眼睛搜索广阔的区域以寻找特定的东西。

scan.en: Scanning means searching a wide area with your eyes to find some particular thing – in this case, edible plants and herbs.
scan.zh: “观察”（Scanning）意味着用眼睛搜索广阔的区域以寻找特定的东西——在这种情况下，是可食用的植物和草药。

scene.en: Because Homer didn’t include this scene to show us that dogs are cute, or sentimental.
scene.zh: 因为荷马加入这一幕并不是为了向我们展示狗有多可爱或多感性。

scene.en: For example, a police officer at a crime scene might say, “Nothing to see here!” to move people on.
scene.zh: 例如，犯罪现场的警察可能会说“这里没什么好看的！”来驱散人群。

scene.en: The cabin was their last hope. On April 3, 1996, a team of FBI agents arrived on the scene.
scene.zh: 木屋是他们最后的希望。1996 年 4 月 3 日，一队 FBI 特工抵达现场。

scene.en: This wasn’t exactly a new player on the scene.
The scenes that followed were very emotional and famous.
scene.zh: 随后的场景非常感人且著名。

scrap.en: As humans moved across the land, we left things behind: specifically, scraps of food.
scrap.zh: 随着人类在大地上迁徙，我们留下了一些东西：具体来说，就是食物残渣。

scrap.en: So, I scrapped them - they simply never saw the light of day.
scrap.zh: 所以，我把它们废弃了——它们从未面世。

scrap.en: Scraping off whatever scraps of rotting meat and gristle remained.
scrap.zh: 刮掉上面残留的任何腐烂的肉和软骨残渣。

scrap.en: Mustafa Kemal scrapped this system entirely.
scrap.zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔彻底废除了这个系统。

scrap.en: And therapists even recommend listing all the good things in your life to feel happier – not bad for a few words on a scrap of paper.
scrap.zh: 治疗师甚至建议列出你生活中的所有美好事物来让自己更快乐——这对于一张纸上的寥寥数语来说相当不错了。

score.en: For example, you can aim for an IELTS score of 7.0 or a Cambridge C1 certificate.
score.zh: 例如，你可以把目标定在雅思7.0分或剑桥C1证书。

score.en: Banks offered subprime mortgages, which were loans given to people with low or risky credit scores.
score.zh: 银行提供次级抵押贷款，即向信用评分低或有风险的人发放贷款。

score.en: The other half saw them as men who had used their badges to settle a private score.
score.zh: 另一半人则认为，他们不过是借着警徽的名义，私下寻仇了结恩怨。

score.en: The style of teaching moves towards activities that improve test scores.
score.zh: 教学风格转向了那些能提高考试成绩的活动。

score.en: While richer countries scored higher on material happiness, middle-income countries did better in terms of kindness and social connection.
score.zh: 虽然较富裕的国家在物质幸福感上得分更高，但中等收入国家在善良和社会联系方面表现更好。

scramble.en: The German Enigma Machine used a series of rotating wheels to scramble messages into billions of possible combinations.
scramble.zh: 德国的 Enigma 机利用一系列旋转的齿轮将信息打乱成数十亿种可能的组合。

scramble.en: Yes. Or not – you know, we've also had cases where we've bitten into something that has a crunch and found an eggshell in our scrambled eggs.
scramble.zh: 是的。或者没有——你知道的，我们也遇到过咬到嘎吱作响的东西却在炒鸡蛋里发现蛋壳的情况。

scramble.en: Meanwhile, political groups that had been crushed under Mubarak, from secular activists to youth movements, trade unions to fledgling political parties, they all scrambled to organise, sensing their opportunity.
scramble.zh: 与此同时，在 Mubarak 统治下遭到打压的政治组织，从世俗活动人士到青年运动、工会到羽翼未丰的政党，都敏锐地嗅到了机会，争先恐后地组织起来。

scent.en: Some even had perfume fountains at their extravagant banquets, spraying scented mist over their guests.
scent.zh: 有些人甚至在他们奢侈的宴会上设置了香水喷泉，向客人们喷洒带香味的雾气。

scent.en: For the Egyptians, scent was as important as gold or fine clothing.
scent.zh: 对于埃及人来说，气味和黄金或华丽的衣服一样重要。

scent.en: And finally, a scent is a distinctive smell, often a pleasant one although it can also mean the smell made by an animal.
scent.zh: 最后，“scent”是一种独特的香味，通常是令人愉悦的，尽管它也可以指动物产生的气味。

scent.en: But even if we can't smell our own homes, the scent of them still matters because it's entangled with our recognition of comfort and security.
scent.zh: 但即使我们闻不到自己家的气味，它的气味依然重要，因为它与我们对舒适和安全的认知交织在一起。

scar.en: By then, 20 people were dead, and Salem was a village full of scars.
scar.zh: 到那时，已有20人丧生，塞勒姆成了一个满目疮痍的村庄。

scar.en: Nobody could cover that up. Find the scar and you’ve found Lucan.
scar.zh: 谁也掩盖不了这一点。找到疤痕，就找到了 Lucan。

scar.en: Lucan had a large scar, 30 centimetres long, on his right thigh.
scar.zh: Lucan 的右大腿上有一条 30 厘米长的巨大疤痕。

scar.en: There are many types of acne from blackheads and whiteheads to more severe forms of cysts and scarring.
scar.zh: 痤疮有许多类型，从黑头、白头到更严重的囊肿和疤痕。

scar.en: He was fearless on the battleground, had been injured multiple times, and had the scars to prove it.
scar.zh: 他在战场上无所畏惧，曾多次受伤，身上的伤疤就是证明。

scarcity.en: In fact, only time will tell if liquid clay is a long-term solution to the problem of water scarcity.
scarcity.zh: 事实上，只有时间才能证明液态粘土是否是解决水资源短缺问题的长期方案。

scarcity.en: What this means is that an entire generation of British people grew up in a society that had experienced food scarcity and limited food choices.
scarcity.zh: 这意味着整整一代英国人是在一个经历过食物匮乏和食物选择有限的社会中长大的。

schedule.en: Possibly four. Some cases, he tells you, are now being scheduled to start in 2029.
schedule.zh: 也可能是四年。他告诉你，有些案子现在被排到了2029年才开庭。

schedule.en: People tend to prioritize their relationships or their experiences more than the schedule.
schedule.zh: 人们往往把人际关系或亲身经历看得比日程安排更重要。

schedule.en: Its scheduled arrival date is 2029, so it will take 6 years for it to get there.
schedule.zh: 它预定的到达日期是 2029 年，这意味着它需要花 6 年时间才能抵达。

schedule.en: Now think about event time. In event time cultures, schedules tend to be more flexible.
schedule.zh: 会议或派对会在每个人都准备好时开始，而不是在一个固定的时间。

schedule.en: My second personal goal was to maintain a consistent gym schedule.
schedule.zh: 我的第二个个人目标是保持规律的健身日程。

scream.en: Show trials were held in the People’s Court, presided over by the raging, screaming judge Roland Freisler.
scream.zh: 公开审判在人民法院举行，由暴怒叫嚣的法官罗兰·弗莱斯勒（Roland Freisler）主持。

scream.en: They screamed about invisible tormentors, pointed fingers, and named names.
scream.zh: 她们尖叫着谈论那些看不见的折磨者，指指点点，并说出具体的名字。

scream.en: Others broke down emotionally, crying and screaming to be let out.
scream.zh: 有些人则情绪崩溃，又哭又喊，求着要被放出去。

scream.en: If a girl screamed in court and said she saw Sarah Good’s spectre choking her, that was enough.
scream.zh: 如果一个女孩在法庭上尖叫，说她看见萨拉·古德的幽灵在掐她，这就足够了。

scream.en: At 315 volts, he screamed violently. After 330 volts, there was silence.
scream.zh: 到315伏特时，他发出了剧烈的尖叫。330伏特之后，一片寂静。

scrape.en: It was close, but Morsi scraped it, with 51.7% of the vote to Shafik’s 48.3%.
scrape.zh: 这是一场势均力敌的较量，但 Morsi 以微弱优势险胜，获得了 51.7% 的选票，而 Shafik 的得票率为 48.3%。

scrape.en: Scraping off whatever scraps of rotting meat and gristle remained.
scrape.zh: 刮掉上面残留的任何腐烂的肉和软骨残渣。

scrape.en: In 2011, nearly 40% of the population still lived below the poverty line, scraping by on less than two dollars a day.
scrape.zh: 2011 年，近 40% 的人口仍然生活在贫困线以下，每天靠不到两美元勉强度日。

scandal.en: Boris Yeltsin himself was deeply unpopular, and his government was plagued by corruption scandals.
scandal.zh: Boris Yeltsin本人极不受欢迎，他的政府也饱受腐败丑闻的困扰。

scandal.en: I will give an example of embezzlement later in the episode with the 1MDB scandal.
scandal.zh: 我会在节目后面通过1MDB丑闻来举个挪用公款的例子。

scandal.en: The boxing scandal had brought his name to a national audience, but for the wrong reasons.
scandal.zh: 那场拳击丑闻虽然让他的名字传遍全国，但原因却并不光彩。

scandal.en: As with cases like the 1MDB scandal or FIFA, corrupt money can move across borders quickly.
scandal.zh: 正如1MDB丑闻或国际足联案那样，腐败资金可以迅速跨越国界。

scandal.en: It’s been struggling with arguments about Brexit, economic issues and inflation, and then various different political scandals.
scandal.zh: 它一直在与关于脱欧的争论、经济问题和通货膨胀，以及各种不同的政治丑闻作斗争。

scholar.en: That name, as the Latin scholars among you will know, simply means upright human.
scholar.zh: 正如你们当中的拉丁语学者所知，这个名字的意思很简单，就是直立的人。

scholar.en: Diplomats and merchants and scholars or travelers might study different languages.
scholar.zh: 外交官、商人、学者或旅行者可能会学习不同的语言。

scholar.en: Patronage refers to financial support given to artists or scholars.
scholar.zh: 赞助是指给予艺术家或学者的资金支持。

scholar.en: Through contact with the Islamic world, in Spain, Sicily, and during the Crusades, European scholars rediscovered long-lost works of ancient philosophers, physicians, and thinkers.
scholar.zh: 通过与西班牙、西西里以及在十字军东征期间与伊斯兰世界的接触，欧洲学者重新发现了古希腊哲学家、医师和思想家长期失传的著作。

scholar.en: In Berlin, Wilhelm von Humboldt developed a new model: the idea that research and teaching should go hand in hand, that scholars should be free to pursue knowledge wherever it might lead.
scholar.zh: 在柏林，威廉·冯·洪堡开发了一种新模式：研究和教学应该齐头并进，学者应该可以自由地追求知识，无论它通向何方。

scarce.en: It turned iron, and later steel, from scarce, expensive materials into industrial commodities.
scarce.zh: 它将铁、以及后来的钢，从稀缺、昂贵的材料变成了工业大宗商品。

scarce.en: Wood for building ships, for building houses, for heating: all of it was scarce and getting increasingly expensive.
scarce.zh: 用于建造船只、建造房屋、取暖的木材：所有这些都十分稀缺，而且变得越来越昂贵。

scarce.en: When resources are scarce, tensions grow.
scarce.zh: 当资源匮乏时，紧张局势就会加剧。

scarce.en: Ingredients were really scarce. People did make delicious food, but perhaps it’s not the food that you’d consider tasty in the 21st century.
scarce.zh: 食材非常匮乏。人们确实做出了美味的食物，但也许那并不是你在21世纪会觉得好吃的食物。

scheme.en: When he left the military in 2007, he used a government scheme called the GI Bill to study at Ohio State University.
scheme.zh: 2007年退伍后，他利用一项名为《退伍军人权利法案》（GI Bill）的政府资助计划进入俄亥俄州立大学学习。

scheme.en: On the other side of Europe, Portugal had a similar scheme which offered residency to people investing in the local property market.
scheme.zh: 在欧洲的另一端，葡萄牙也有类似的计划，为投资当地房地产市场的人提供居留权。

scheme.en: Only in the 1970s did Australia introduce a scheme that allowed some residents more control over where they lived and their futures.
scheme.zh: 直到 20 世纪 70 年代，澳大利亚才推出了一项计划，允许一些居民对他们的居住地和未来有更多的控制权。

sceptical.en: Others are more sceptical and worry that the excitement has gone too far.
sceptical.zh: 另一些人则更加持怀疑态度，担心这种狂热已经走得太远了。

sceptical.en: But others were more sceptical. They said it was less about pride and more about power.
sceptical.zh: 但另一些人则更为怀疑。他们认为这与其说是关于自豪感，不如说是关于权力。

sceptical.en: American doctors were deeply sceptical. If it was caused by botulism, it was unlike anything they had ever seen.
sceptical.zh: 美国医生对此深表怀疑。如果这真是肉毒中毒引起的，那也和他们以往见过的任何病例都不一样。

scatter.en: France has territory that is scattered across the Atlantic, Caribbean, Indian Ocean, and the Pacific.
scatter.zh: 法国的领地散布在大西洋、加勒比海、印度洋和太平洋。

scatter.en: They were carved between the years 1250 and 1500, and there are more than 900 of them scattered across the island.
scatter.zh: 它们雕刻于公元1250年至1500年之间，全岛散落着900多尊这样的石像。

scatter.en: Some of it remained as loose chunks of rock and metal scattered throughout the solar system—what we now call asteroids.
scatter.zh: 其中一部分作为松散的岩石和金属块残留在太阳系各处——也就是我们现在所说的小行星。

scatter.en: Some of these are in the Caribbean, some in the Indian Ocean, one is in South America, and others are scattered across the Pacific Ocean.
scatter.zh: 其中一些位于加勒比海，一些在印度洋，一个在南美洲，还有一些散落在大平洋各处。

scatter.en: Now, although by the 14th century or so, universities were well-established, and there were around 50 scattered across Europe, they still only educated an extreme minority of the population, so we’re probably talking about fewer than 50,000 students at every university in total.
scatter.zh: 现在，尽管到了 14 世纪左右，大学已经相当成熟，欧洲各地散落着大约 50 所大学，但它们仍然只教育了极少数的人口，所以我们可能在讨论所有大学总共不到 50,000 名学生。

scissors.en: Some economists argue that a blanket minimum wage is a blunt tool, like trying to tend to a flowerbed with a lawnmower instead of precise little scissors.
scissors.zh: 一些经济学家认为，一刀切的最低工资是一种笨拙的工具，就像试图用割草机而不是精细的小剪刀来打理花坛一样。

scorch.en: As the camel obediently plods forward, putting one foot in front of the other in the scorching desert sand, you hear the words of the narrator, ostensibly about the man on the camel.
scorch.zh: 随着骆驼在滚烫的沙漠中顺从地一步步向前挪动，你会听到旁白的声音，表面上是在谈论骆驼上的那个男人。

scope.en: The EU also expanded in scope. The Euro was introduced in 1999.
scope.zh: 欧盟的范围也在扩大。欧元于1999年正式推出。

scope.en: His plan was straightforward and audacious: travel into uncharted territory, gather fresh evidence, and come out triumphant—maybe with gold, maybe with tales of a living civilisation beyond the scope of imagination.
scope.zh: 他的计划直接而大胆：深入未知的领土，收集新的证据，然后凯旋而归——也许带着黄金，也许带着超越想象力的活文明的故事。

sculpture.en: These are giant sculptures weighing up to 50 tons and possibly represent their rulers.
sculpture.zh: 这些巨大的雕塑重达50吨，可能代表了他们的统治者。

sculpture.en: He learned painting, drawing, sculpture, mechanics, and basic engineering.
sculpture.zh: 他学习了绘画、素描、雕塑、机械学和基础工程学。

scenery.en: But behind the beautiful scenery and joyful name lies a far more complicated, and often dark, history.
scenery.zh: 但在美丽的风景和欢乐的名字背后，隐藏着一段更加复杂、而且往往黑暗的历史。

scholarship.en: In 1903, for example, he had been given a scholarship to the University of Madras, but he lost the scholarship a year later after failing every class other than mathematics.
scholarship.zh: 例如，在1903年，他曾获得马德拉斯大学的奖学金，但一年后因为除数学外所有课程都不及格而失去了奖学金。

scholarship.en: In 1903, for example, he had been given a scholarship to the University of Madras, but he lost the scholarship a year later after failing every class other than mathematics.
scholarship.zh: 例如，在1903年，他曾获得马德拉斯大学的奖学金，但一年后因为除数学外所有课程都不及格而失去了奖学金。

screw.en: So he replaced them. He added a new glass cover, new hands, a new strap, new springs and screws inside the movement, which is the parts that makes the watch work.
screw.zh: 所以他更换了它们。他加了一个新的玻璃镜面、新的指针、新的表带、机芯内部的新弹簧和螺丝，机芯就是让手表运转的部件。
